json-schema-validator.name: JSON Schema Validator
json-schema-validator.description: Validate JSON locally against a draft-07 schema and inspect error paths.

meta.title: JSON Schema Validator — Draft 07
meta.description: Check JSON data against JSON Schema draft-07 without sending data to a server.
meta.keywords: JSON Schema, draft-07, validation, error paths

json-schema-validator.draft: JSON Schema draft-07. References must be defined within the schema; remote references are never fetched.
json-schema-validator.valid: Valid: the data matches the schema.
json-schema-validator.invalid: Invalid: the data does not match the schema.
json-schema-validator.schemaError: Invalid or unsupported schema, or unresolved reference.

url-parser.name: URL Parser
url-parser.description: Parse and rebuild URLs while preserving repeated query keys and empty values.

meta.title: URL Parser and Builder
meta.description: Edit URL components and query parameters locally with strict encoding checks.

url-parser.hint: Absolute HTTP(S) URLs without credentials. Query fields contain decoded text; path and fragment retain percent encoding.
url-parser.urlError: Invalid URL or component. Check protocol, host, port and delimiters.
url-parser.encodingError: Invalid percent encoding or UTF-8 sequence.

yaml-formatter.name: YAML Formatter
yaml-formatter.description: Format and validate YAML locally using a safe data schema.

meta.title: YAML Formatter and Validator
meta.description: Validate YAML and format it with two-space indentation using a safe schema.

yaml-formatter.hint: Safe JSON-compatible types; comments and original layout are not retained. Custom executable tags are rejected.

xml-formatter.name: XML Formatter
xml-formatter.description: Format, minify and validate XML while preserving mixed text and attributes.

meta.title: XML Formatter and Validator
meta.description: Process XML locally while preserving declarations, attributes, mixed text and existing whitespace.

xml-formatter.hint: Existing text whitespace is preserved, including in compact output. Indentation is added only between elements without text. DTDs are not supported.

subnet-calculator.name: IPv4 Subnet Calculator
subnet-calculator.description: Calculate IPv4 network ranges, masks and membership from CIDR notation.

meta.title: IPv4 CIDR Subnet Calculator
meta.description: Calculate network, broadcast, usable hosts and address membership, including /0, /31 and /32.

subnet-calculator.hint: /31 uses both addresses for point-to-point links; /32 has one usable address.
subnet-calculator.cidrError: Invalid IPv4 address or CIDR prefix (0–32).

number-base-converter.name: Number Base and Byte Converter
number-base-converter.description: Convert signed integers exactly between bases and byte quantities between SI and IEC units.

meta.title: Number Base and Byte Unit Converter
meta.description: Convert large integers in binary, octal, decimal and hexadecimal, plus exact SI and IEC byte units.
meta.keywords: number base, BigInt, binary, hexadecimal, SI, IEC, bytes

number-base-converter.integerHint: Signed integers without prefixes or separators. Large values retain full precision.
number-base-converter.bytesHint: Nonnegative decimal quantities. SI uses powers of 1000; IEC uses powers of 1024. Results are exact, without rounding.
number-base-converter.numberError: Enter a complete integer using only digits valid for the selected base.
number-base-converter.bytesError: Enter a nonnegative decimal quantity and supported byte units.

certificate-parser.name: Certificate Parser
certificate-parser.description: Inspect a PEM X.509 certificate locally, including identity, dates and SHA-256 fingerprint.

meta.title: PEM X.509 Certificate Parser
meta.description: Read certificate subject, issuer, alternative names, validity dates and SHA-256 fingerprint locally.

certificate-parser.hint: One certificate at a time. Parsing does not verify signatures, trust chains or revocation status.
certificate-parser.subject: Subject
certificate-parser.certificateError: Invalid PEM X.509 certificate. Paste exactly one certificate.
